answer_1.quote: We evaluate LLMs on the generation variant ( §6.2).
answer_1.outputs: plausible explanations of vague texts given social context

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models using macro-averaged precision, recall, F1, and accuracy metrics (due to class imbalance, we focus on macro-F1).

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 97 questions and ask annotators to answer them as multiple-choice questions. Each vague text-context pair was given 4 choices out of which only one was correct. We provide a brief event description along with all the metadata available to the annotator. Each question was answered by 3 annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Each vague text-context pair was given 4 choices out of which only one was correct. We provide a brief event description along with all the metadata available to the annotator.
